annotations.title: Ask Agitech for the full written report

description: Asks the Agitech team for a full written audit of the website: six checks, what to fix first and why, reviewed by a person and sent by email. Only use this when the person asks for it and gives their own name and work email. Their name, email and website go to Agitech, who may get in touch about the report. Nothing is sent to them until the team has reviewed it.

email.description: The person's own work email, where the report should go.

website.description: The website address, for example yourcompany.com.
